title: Modifying Data
description: Insert, update, delete, and merge data safely. Learn about transactions, error handling with TRY...CATCH, and the MERGE statement.
whatYouLearn: How to INSERT single and multiple rows into a table
How to INSERT results from one query into another table
How to UPDATE and DELETE rows safely with proper WHERE clauses
How the MERGE statement combines insert, update, and delete in one operation
How transactions and TRY...CATCH protect data integrity
